title: [MSc] Computer Sciences and Engineering - Thesis
institution: Koç University, Graduate School of Sciences and Engineering
about: Koç University's thesis-based MSc in Computer Sciences and Engineering accepts applications for the Spring 2027 intake until 5 December 2026. The full-time programme is taught in English, and applicants are automatically considered for merit-based scholarships.
requirements: Spring 2026/27 intake; application deadline 5 Dec 2026, 23:59:59 Turkey time
English-taught, full-time MSc; thesis option requires a minimum of 21 credits (7 courses) beyond a bachelor's degree
Applicants are automatically considered for the scholarships available for the programme; awards based on academic success and potential

upskill.name: the AI Foundations Academy page
why: Field "Computer science and engineering" → AI Foundations Academy topics such as "Supervised learning: classification, regression, decision trees, SVMs, ensemble methods" (A001.01) and "Classical search: A*, heuristic search, constraint propagation" (A001.13). No single course objective covers the programme's stated requirements, which are administrative (credits, English-taught, scholarships), so the Academy page is linked instead of a specific course.
